newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Spanish trawler makes for Ireland after alert.
newsitem.headline: Spanish trawler makes for Ireland after alert.

text.p: A Spanish trawler with 15 crew was heading for an Irish port under its own power on Saturday after overcoming an onboard flood that had threatened to sink the vessel.
The captain of the Eclipse 2 had earlier sent out a Mayday signal saying his vessel would sink in about four hours if the water could not be pumped out.
Irish coastguards dispatched a helicopter carrying a pump to aid the vessel which at the time was about 160 miles off the southwest coast of Ireland.
A coastguard spokesman said it appeared that a broken pipe had caused the flooding. None of the crew were evacuated.
The spokesman said the trawler was expected to arrive at the small port of Castletownbere around noon on Sunday.
